text:
Maria (eng-platform): Heads up - HorizonPay is seeing a spike in 5xxs and p99 latency on embeddings since ~02:00 UTC. Customer on Dedicated. This looks like an SLA risk if not mitigated quickly. Need owners and a short-term workaround + ETA for a fix.

Alex (eng-runtime): On it. I'm seeing KV cache thrashing on their pool, plus a few OOMs in the last hour. Can we try routing a portion of traffic to the backup pool and fall back to the q4-quant model?

Devon (eng-infra): I can warm up the backup pool, but need an OK for burst capacity. How much headroom do we need?

Samir (eng-sre): I requested a temporary burst increase from autoscaler policy. Finance/quotas pending. If approved we can add 4 warm GPUs to the pool.

Maria (eng-platform): Short plan proposal: 1) short-term (0-30m): route 30% traffic to backup pool + enable quantized fallback for embeddings. 2) mid-term (4-24h): fix kernel that causes OOM under long sequences. 3) customer comms and SLA note. Approve?

Alex (eng-runtime): Agree. I have a small routing change ready in PR #5678. Needs a quick review and CI pass. Code snippet to flip:```yaml
route:
  - condition: embedding_latency>500ms
    action: route_to: backup-pool
    percent: 30
```

Camille (eng-ml): I can prepare the q4 quantized variant and run a smoke eval. Might take ~20m to generate artifacts and publish to model-catalog.

Tasha (customer-success): I'll draft a short message to HorizonPay once we confirm the fallback is working. Need exact timeline to share.

Devon (eng-infra): Quota team approved a one-time bump for 4 GPUs for 2 hours. Starting warm-up now.

Samir (eng-sre): Rolling config: enabling fallback policy and increasing pool size. I'll monitor p95/p99 and post metrics.

Alex (eng-runtime): Ping for review: @Camille @Samir can someone review PR #5678? It's one-line and flips the routing rule.

Camille (eng-ml): Reviewing now. Quick question: does quantized model support the same embedding dim/normalization? Need to ensure vector compatibility.

Alex (eng-runtime): Yes, Camille — same dim and post-normalization. We already validated 1000 sample vectors locally.

Samir (eng-sre): Metrics update (2m since ops): p99 for embeddings down from 1.2s -> 430ms after routing to backup pool. Error rate also dropped. Continuing to watch.

Tasha (customer-success): That's great. I'll ping HorizonPay with: "We routed a portion of your traffic to a warm backup pool and enabled a temporary quantized fallback. Expect lower errors and latency; we'll follow up with a permanent fix timeline." Anything to add?

Maria (eng-platform): No, that's good. Owners: Alex (runtime routing & PR), Camille (quantized artifact + smoke), Devon (infra warm pool), Samir (monitoring & rollback), Tasha (customer comms). Target: short-term mitigation within 30m, root cause & hotfix in 24h.

Camille (eng-ml): I'm unblocked and publishing the q4 artifact now. ETA ~18m.

Devon (eng-infra): Backup pool is warm. Routing flip queued once PR merges.

Alex (eng-runtime): PR merged and deployed to canary. Rolling to 30% now.

ops-bot: deploy-bot posted: "canary deploy succeeded: routing-config v2026.03.18-1712"

Samir (eng-sre): Canary metrics look good. Will continue 30% for 10m then scale to 50% if stable.

Tasha (customer-success): Sent customer note and tagged them for monitoring. They replied: "Thanks - we're seeing improvements on our side." :thumbsup:

Maria (eng-platform): Excellent. Keep this thread updated with any regressions or if we need to extend burst capacity. If anyone needs wider help, ping #eng-oncall.

Alex (eng-runtime): Quick note - I'll open a follow-up issue for the kernel fix and tag infra+runtime. Link will be in the issue tracker within the hour.

Camille (eng-ml): Smoke eval passed on quantized model. No vector drift detected. :white_check_mark:

Samir (eng-sre): Marking short-term as resolved for now. Moving to a post-mortem doc to track RCA and next steps.

Maria (eng-platform): Thanks everyone. Closing loop in 24h after hotfix PR and post-mortem."
